mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. Current FEDFUNDS at 0.09% is historically low.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls below 0.5%, it signals sustained monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 2.5% signals a stable monetary environment that supports positive equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL < 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), accommodative monetary policy reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,100,000 units, it signals strong consumer demand and business investment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1100.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 6.5%, it signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 100 and employment (PAYEMS) rises above 136,876,000 persons, it signals a strong economy that supports positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO > 100 AND PAYEMS > 136876.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong housing market (HOUST > 1,100,000 units), robust consumer demand and business investment support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1100.
